## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.9`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/useTopLevelDescribe`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`test`](/linter/domains#test)
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`jest/require-top-level-describe`](https://github.com/jest-community/eslint-plugin-jest/blob/main/docs/rules/require-top-level-describe.md)
  - Same as [`vitest/require-top-level-describe`](https://github.com/vitest-dev/eslint-plugin-vitest/blob/main/docs/rules/require-top-level-describe.md)
  - Same as [`playwright/require-top-level-describe`](https://github.com/playwright-community/eslint-plugin-playwright/blob/main/docs/rules/require-top-level-describe.md)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"useTopLevelDescribe": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Require tests and hooks to be inside a `describe` block.

A `describe` block gives a group of tests a shared name and keeps their
hooks next to them. A hook is a function such as `beforeEach` or
`afterAll` that runs before or after tests. Tests and hooks written
outside of any `describe` block have no such group, which makes a test
file harder to navigate as it grows.

This rule reports calls that declare a test, such as `test` and `it`,
and calls that declare a hook, when they are not inside a `describe`
block. It can also limit how many `describe` blocks a file has at its
top level.

Tests and hooks are recognized by the name of the function, such as
`test`, `it`, `beforeEach`, or `after`. The rule doesn't check where
that function comes from, so an unrelated function with one of these
names is reported as well.

## Examples

### Invalid

```js
test("adds two numbers", () => {});
```

### Valid

```js
describe("calculator", () => {
    beforeEach(() => {});

    test("adds two numbers", () => {});

    describe("division", () => {
        test("divides two numbers", () => {});
    });
});
```

## Options

### `maxTopLevelDescribes`

Default: no limit

The maximum number of `describe` blocks allowed at the top level of a file.
A `describe` block that is inside another `describe` block doesn't count
towards this limit.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"useTopLevelDescribe": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"maxTopLevelDescribes": 1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

```js
describe("addition", () => {
    test("adds two numbers", () => {});
});

describe("division", () => {
    test("divides two numbers", () => {});
});
```
